VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) confirms 64 tests pass, satisfying criterion (2). However, there is no admissible evidence that criterion (1)—the rounding drift bug is actually fixed—is met. The self-report claims the fix is complete, but that is SELF-class and not independently verifiable. The CI log only shows existing tests pass; it does not demonstrate a new test covering the rounding drift was added, nor that the passing tests exercise the netting rounding behavior. Passing tests are consistent with the bug never having been covered. Without evidence tying the test suite to the specific defect, the fix itself is unverified.
